source_basis: Official COCO download page; only metadata bundle and per-image objects, never the image archive
license_policy: Only metadata-declared CC BY2.0/3.0/4.0 URLs plus Flickr owner account and photoID. Preserve original license/attribution; no image redistribution in Git. Display names and current rights not independently certified. Stop for login/payment/new acceptance/access restriction.
ranking: ascending SHA256(seed|cover|COCO_ID), separate seed|caption|COCO_ID; exact code fixed by workerSHA
eligibility: Valid COCO2017val filename/URL and positive dimensions<=20M pixels; at least200 eligible source IDs; no semantic/content/target-score selection
exclusions: Known explicit historicalCOCO IDs, source bytes,originalRGB pixels,canonicalRGB512 pixels; 63AC-bit pHash with DC bit0 and median threshold, Hamming<=4, against prior bank and accepted covers; disjoint FlickrphotoIDs; unique NFKC-casefold-whitespace-normalized captions excluding historical prompt hashes; lowest valid captionAnnotationID per ranked source
scope_limit: No finite audit proves all prior development use absent. AnonymousCOCO_1..10 are not original IDs. Prior transformed/undocumented/out-of-project uses may escape. No foundation-training-unseen claim.
preprocessing: Pillow11: Image.open(source).resize((512,512)).convert(RGB), no EXIF correction or semantic changes; raw JPG retained
failure_policy: No automatic retries, no access workaround, no relaxed selection rules; preserve partial files and all failed/excluded candidates. Existing outputs are never overwritten.
confirmation_use: Frozen baseline confirmation only; never method/hyperparameter selection, never inspect target scores during development. No model generation, attack optimization, keys/messages or service credentials generated.
publication: Only protocol,manifests,hashes,metadata attribution,logs,and acquisition/verification scripts; no raw JPG,canonical PNG or annotation archive in GitHub.
